description: This file defines the `BasicExpiringValue` class, a generic implementation of an expiring cache value that holds a value of type T and an expiration timestamp. It provides methods to retrieve the value and check if it has expired based on current or provided timestamp.

classes.name: BasicExpiringValue
classes.description: A generic class representing a cache value with an expiration time, implementing the ExpiringValue interface.

methods.name: BasicExpiringValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the value and expiration time, requiring non-null inputs.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the current time has passed the expiration time.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a given Instant has passed the expiration time.
